Source Monster

Monster: Tetranadon | CR: 6 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

(Ranged weapon only) Aim Booster. Before you make an attack with this weapon, you can use your bonus action to grant yourself advantage on the attack roll. You can use this property a number of times equal to 1/2 your proficiency modifier, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Armor Effect

Evade Extender (S). You have a +1 bonus to Dexterity saving throws while you wear this armor.

Tags: weapon-type:ranged, mechanic:bonus-action, mechanic:advantage, mechanic:long-rest
